_note: Animal classes (every animal has one, in animals.json "class") and the Specialists' traits ("trait"). Rows: where a class starts, in tiles back from the middle line (Air hovers over its row). counters: extra damage (percent) one class does to another. A class's targets and range override the animal's own (Ranged reach at least `range` tiles; Air flies). line: the one short line shown when you hold a card.

classes.name: Air
classes.line: Flies. Only Ranged and Air can hit it.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.line: Digs under and pops up behind the enemy.

traits.name: Stun
traits.line: Every third hit freezes the target.

prefer._note: Who goes after what first, if it's within this many tiles: Tank Destroyers look for Tanks, Ranged for Air.

rows._note: Rows in tiles back from the middle line. Animals in a row stand `spacing` tiles apart; a row too full for the field's width wraps into another `depth` tiles further back.
